- [ ] Sourcing the 5-line probe with `DEVICE_HAS_ARMHF=Y` and `GT_ARMHF_LIBDL` pointing at a missing file yields `N`; pointing at an existing file yields `Y`; `N` stays `N`
- [ ] Staged `device_info.txt` has `DEVICE_CPU=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | grep` with the `gt-h700-lscpu` marker, exactly once; `sh -n` passes
- [ ] `make test` → `ALL TESTS PASSED`
